Sabre / 100 designs

Moderately curved single-edged cavalry sabre with a clearly visible D-shaped knuckle bow or half-basket hand guard, one-hand grip. Slender sweeping blade with a tapered pointed tip; distinct from a broad scimitar.

Each row is one path. T1–T5 describe the visual stage within that path. Click artwork for a larger preview. Thumbnails are embedded when exports are present, so the finished browser travels with the native engine documentation.
